consent.body:
Namaste! This is the WhatsApp assistant of {clinic}.

To book and manage appointments we store your name, phone number and appointment times. We use them only for your appointments and reminders. Reply STOP at any time to stop messages, or DELETE MY DATA to erase your data.

Do you agree?
consent.declined: No problem. We have not stored anything. You can call the clinic on {phone} to book.
menu.body: How can I help you today? You can also type your question.
optout.ack: You will not receive any more messages from us. Reply START to receive messages again.
optin.ack: Welcome back! You will receive appointment messages again.
emergency.body: This may be an emergency. Please call 108 or 112 now, or go to the nearest hospital immediately. You can also call the clinic on {phone}. Our staff have been alerted.
emergency.staff_alert: EMERGENCY keyword from patient {who}. Please call them back urgently.
handoff.patient: I have passed your message to our clinic staff. Someone will reply to you here shortly.
handoff.staff_alert: Patient {who} needs a human reply (reason: {reason}). Open the handoff inbox.
handoff.forward: Message from {who} (handoff active). Reply from the admin handoff inbox.
unsupported_type: Sorry, I can only read text messages. Please type your message, or call the clinic on {phone}.
fallback_error: Sorry, something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment or call the clinic on {phone}.
slots.list_body: Here are the available times. Please pick one.
slots.none: Sorry, there are no free slots for that day. Would you like another day, or shall I add you to the waitlist?
slots.retry: Sorry, that time was just taken. Here are the latest free times.
ask_name: Please type the patient's full name.
book.limit: You already have {max} upcoming appointments. Please cancel one first or call the clinic on {phone}.
book.failed: Sorry, I could not book that right now. Please try again or call the clinic on {phone}.
book.expired: That booking request has expired. Let's pick a time again.
book.rule_line: If you are more than {grace} minutes late, the next patient will be called and you will be seen after {reinsert} patients once you arrive.
cancel.pick: Which appointment would you like to cancel?
cancel.not_allowed: You are already checked in at the clinic. Please speak to the reception desk.
cancel.too_late: It is too close to your appointment to change it here. Please call the clinic on {phone}.
resched.pick: Which appointment would you like to move?
late.ask_minutes: Sorry to hear that. About how late will you be?
late.ack: Thanks for letting us know. Your turn is kept only until {grace} minutes after your slot. If you arrive after that, you will be seen after {reinsert} waiting patients.
late.ack_long: Thanks for letting us know. Since you will be more than {max_late} minutes late, you will be seen at the end of the session once you arrive. Reception may suggest another time.
late.no_appt: I could not find an appointment for you today.
arrived.ack: Thank you. Please tell the reception desk you have arrived so they can check you in.
onway.ack: Great, see you soon. Please report at the reception desk when you arrive.
confirm24.ack: Thank you, your appointment is confirmed.
delay_ok.ack: Thank you. We will see you soon.
offer.taken: Sorry, this slot has already been taken. Your appointment is unchanged.
waitlist.declined: Okay. You are still on the waitlist.
waitlist.joined: You are on the waitlist for {date} (position {position}). We will message you if a slot frees up. This is not a confirmed booking.
waitlist.has_slots: There are free slots on that day, so there is no need for the waitlist. Here they are.
fu.not_now: Okay. Message us whenever you would like to book.
queue.status: Your token: {token}. Status: {status}. Patients ahead of you: {ahead}. Now with the doctor: {current}. Your expected time is approx {eta}. Please keep your report-by time.
queue.none_today: You do not have an appointment today.
delete.done: Your data has been deleted and your upcoming appointments cancelled. Thank you.
lang.set: Okay, I will reply in English.
stale: Sorry, that option is no longer valid.
medical.refuse: I'm sorry, I can't give medical advice. The doctor will discuss this with you at your visit. Would you like to book an appointment?
mock.fallback: I can help you book, view, move or cancel appointments, or share clinic details.
mock.slots_sent: Please pick a time from the list above.
mock.injection: I can only book one appointment at a time, and only after you confirm it.
tpl.appt_confirmation.body: Hello {{1}}, your appointment on {{2}} is confirmed. Token: {{3}}. Expected time: approx {{4}}. Please report by {{5}}. Doctor: {{6}}.
tpl.appt_reminder_24h.body: Reminder: {{1}}, you have an appointment on {{2}}. Token: {{3}}. Expected time: approx {{4}}.
tpl.appt_reminder_24h.confirm_note: Please tap Confirm within 12 hours, otherwise this booking will be released.
tpl.appt_reminder_2h.body: {{1}}, your appointment is today. Token: {{2}}. Current expected time: approx {{3}}. Address: {{4}}.
tpl.queue_turn_soon.body: Token {{1}}: your turn is coming soon. Patients ahead: {{2}}. Expected time: approx {{3}}.
tpl.queue_delay_notice.body: Token {{1}}: the clinic is running late. Your new expected time is approx {{2}}.
tpl.queue_missed_turn.body: Token {{1}}: we called your turn but you were not at the clinic. {{2}}
tpl.queue_missed_turn.line: When you arrive, you will be seen after the patients already waiting.
tpl.appt_no_show.body: {{1}}, we missed you at your appointment on {{2}}. Would you like to book again?
tpl.followup_reminder.body: Hello {{1}}, {{2}} asked for a follow-up visit around {{3}}. Would you like to book it?
tpl.appt_cancelled.body: {{1}}, your appointment on {{2}} (token {{3}}) has been cancelled.
tpl.appt_rescheduled.body: {{1}}, your appointment has moved to {{2}}. New token: {{3}}. Expected time: approx {{4}}. Please report by {{5}}.
tpl.slot_offer_earlier.body: {{1}}, an earlier time has opened up. Your current booking: {{2}}. Earlier time available: {{3}}. Reply within {{4}} minutes if you would like to move.
tpl.waitlist_offer.body: {{1}}, a slot has opened on {{2}} at {{3}}. Reply within {{4}} minutes to book it.
tpl.token_updated.body: {{1}}, your token number has changed from {{2}} to {{3}}. Your expected time is unchanged: approx {{4}}.
tpl.session_cancelled_by_clinic.body: {{1}}, we are sorry: the doctor is unavailable on {{2}} ({{3}}), so your appointment is cancelled. Would you like to reschedule?
